name: web-teal-pixel-dither-gradient-background
title: Teal dithered pixel gradient rising from deep green to white with scanlines
whatItIs: A wide image where a mountain-like mass of teal and dark green pixel dither rises against a white-to-cyan sky, with faint horizontal scanlines.
whatItMeans: Retro-digital and cool; dither turns a gradient into a texture.
techniques: Build a gradient from dithered pixels.
Keep to teal, green and white.
Use as a hero or cover backdrop.

vocabulary.definition: A pattern of dots that simulates a gradient.
Thin horizontal lines like a CRT.
A shape formed by pixel noise.
